text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic female character portrait. Long dark brown waves over one shoulder, fair pink-neutral skin, blue-gray eyes, full brows, oval face, softly parted pink lips. Crisp white collared shirt with burgundy and navy striped tie. Three-quarter shoulders, face toward viewer with a slight tilt. Single person on a seamless pure white background, vertical composition with the entire head visible and breathing space above the hair. Bright soft frontal studio daylight, low-contrast natural shadows, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, restrained makeup, subtle halation, realistic 50mm perspective, coherent cream-white and warm-brown color grading. Upper-body portrait; retain visible clothing texture and natural folds. No text, watermark, logo, collage, border, other people, scenery, plastic skin, illustration or CGI rendering.
reproduction_note: 根据已确认成图重建独立文生图提示词；未进行纯文字重生成相似度验证，严格保持身份时需结合此成图。

original_prompt: Generate a NEW single-person photorealistic character portrait on a COMPLETELY SOLID PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) BACKGROUND. WHITE BACKGROUND IS MANDATORY, edge-to-edge behind the subject, no dark corners or gradient. This is one standalone portrait, no collage or panels. First input is visual inspiration for hair and outfit only: invent a new fictional face, do not reproduce reference pixels or exact facial identity. Second input sets the approved soft bright photographic lighting and white background only. Use high-key neutral daylight, broad soft frontal illumination, minimal shadows, fine natural skin texture, subtle halation, 50mm perspective. Young appearance consistent with source; no arbitrary ethnicity changes. No illustration, CGI, plastic skin, dark color grading, heavy makeup, text, badges, logos or watermark. Fully clothed mid-torso casting portrait, whole head with white margin. Character direction: Long dark softly waved hair swept behind one shoulder; simple white school shirt and burgundy navy striped tie; slight three-quarter gaze. Final requirement: entire backdrop is flat pure white, including all four corners.
